name: Amolen
summary: Colour- and character-led consumer filament brand founded in 2017 and operating from Los Angeles, California. With roughly four employees it is a brand/import company rather than an extruder; manufacturing is outsourced and almost certainly Chinese, though no factory or OEM has been confirmed.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: Basic/High-Speed at $21.99/kg plus Galaxy Series, Silk S-Series, wood, marble/granite, glow-in-the-dark and colour-changing variants

additional_notes: Address on file is 8271 Melrose Ave Suite 200, Los Angeles, CA 90046. manufacturing_countries is left empty rather than asserting China: no OEM is disclosed, and the only lead is a Shanghai B2B supplier (Shanghai Maijie Industrial Co., Ltd.) listing 'Amolen Filament products', which reads as a reseller/distributor listing and is explicitly not treated as a manufacturing statement. Amolen's own about page claims materials 'sourced from the United States and made from biodegradable corn starch' for at least some PLA; given the company's size and the absence of any known US extrusion facility this is read as PLA-feedstock marketing language, not evidence of US manufacturing. A 2025 '8 years' anniversary post implies continuous operation since 2017. Instagram, YouTube and X presence was not confirmed. No build plates were found, but this is an unverified negative so makes_plates is left unset.

provenance.conflicts: Amolen's own 'sourced from the United States' PLA claim conflicts with every structural indicator (four employees, no known US extrusion capacity, brand-style operation); this entry treats it as marketing language and asserts no manufacturing country at all. The Shanghai Maijie listing is the sole OEM lead and is judged a distributor listing, so no oem_relationship is recorded.
